title: How is Nelson Mandela connected to Napoleon?
description:
Five photos and two paintings link Nelson Mandela to Napoleon.

Nelson Mandela → George W. Bush → Gerald Ford → Richard Nixon → Edward VIII → Queen Victoria → Napoleon III → Napoleon

How they're connected (every photo is real and sourced):
1. Nelson Mandela → George W. Bush: In 2005, Nelson Mandela visited George W. Bush in the Oval Office.
   Photo, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:President_George_W._Bush_and_Former_President_Nelson_Mandela_of_South_Africa_Meet_in_the_Oval_Office.jpg
2. George W. Bush → Gerald Ford: In 2006, Bush dropped in on Gerald Ford at his home in Rancho Mirage, California.
   Photo by George W. Bush Presidential Library, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:President_George_W._Bush,_Former_President_Gerald_Ford_and_Mrs._Betty_Ford_Greet_the_Media_in_Rancho_Mirage,_California_(P042306ED-1123).jpg
3. Gerald Ford → Richard Nixon: In 1973, Richard Nixon picked Ford as his vice president; a year later Ford had his job.
   Photo, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Mr._and_Mrs._Ford_and_Nixon_13_Oct_1973.jpg
4. Richard Nixon → Edward VIII: In 1970, Nixon threw a White House dinner for Edward the Eighth, the king who gave up his throne.
   Photo, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Nixon_and_the_Windsors.jpg
5. Edward VIII → Queen Victoria: Back in 1894, baby Edward sat on the lap of his great-grandmother, Queen Victoria.
   Photo by Percy Lewis Pocock, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Edward_VIII_Christening.webp
6. Queen Victoria → Napoleon III: This painting shows Victoria in 1855, visiting Napoleon's tomb in Paris with Emperor Napoleon the Third.
   Photo by Edward Matthew Ward, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Edward_Matthew_Ward_(1816-79)_-_Queen_Victoria_at_the_Tomb_of_Napoleon,_24_August_1855_-_RCIN_402019_-_Royal_Collection.jpg
7. Napoleon III → Napoleon: And in this 1810 painting, the baby on Napoleon's knee is his nephew, the future Napoleon the Third.
   Photo by Jean Louis Ducis, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Napol%C3%A9on_enfants_Saint-Cloud.jpg

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.
